data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 雪凇高地哨所观风
data.action: 立于积雪岩台边缘单手扶弓远眺回眸
data.lighting: 清冽冷调的雪地晨光与微弱暖金日出边光
data.description: 晨霜还未从哨所护栏上散去，提弗洛斯踩着碎雪站在岩台边，一手轻按腰侧战术扣、微微偏头朝你看来。冷风拂过她的薰衣草色长发与深色龙角，粉紫双眸清亮沉静——「西北方的风里混着侵蚀体的腥气。先别急着下坡，我从上面替你清出路来。」
data.promptProse: Standing at the edge of a snow-dusted highland outpost with crisp morning sunlight catching her horns and lavender hair, Typhoeus rests one hand on her hip and looks back toward the viewer with a calm, sharp hunter's smile.
data.animaCaption: She stands poised at the snowy cliffside railing, wind lifting her hair as she looks toward the viewer with quiet confidence.
